text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend three candidates for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live: CTT2-349; CTT2-358; CTT2-370; CTT2-378; CTT2-387; and CTT2-388. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (April 2, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live.
